title: Moss Queen Carriage
description: A woman with long curly green hair and a crown sits atop an ornate carriage covered in moss and draped with pink fabric. She holds a lit lantern containing a small figure while floating bubbles with miniature scenes drift around her against a dramatic cloudy sky with light rays from a vine arch.
prompt: A regal woman with long curly green hair wearing a crown and brown corset dress sits on an ornate carriage overgrown with moss and pink drapery, floating above dark water. She holds a gothic lantern containing a tiny figure inside. Transparent bubbles float around her containing miniature fantasy scenes. Dramatic cloudy sky with god rays beaming through a vine-covered arch, ethereal fantasy style.
